content.text:
Yes, line 80 (`echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH`) already adds `~/.local/bin` to PATH. But that's not relevant for roger-roger — it installs to `/usr/local/bin` (via `GOBIN=/usr/local/bin`), which is already on PATH by default on Ubuntu runners. The `$HOME/.local/bin` addition is for the other agents (claude-code, opencode, cursor-cli) whose install scripts place binaries there.

So there's no redundancy issue here — the two PATH concerns are separate.
